verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows extensive tooling for chargeback/dispute management (webhook forwarding, evidence automation, Stripe dispute mapping, recommendation engine) but contains no mention of a financial liability-shift guarantee, reimbursement terms, or coverage conditions for approved-then-disputed orders — the core of this finance-lead story. Missing for 10: any documentation of a reimbursement/guarantee program, coverage terms, claim payout process, or liability-shift contract language.
